author: Owen Petrakis, analyser desk contractor
notes: Round two is in: four slots on the header, two before ten and two after two.
The 12th was the coldest day of the month so far, minus six on the wall gauge when I came through the yard.
The plant-room set was being changed over in the afternoon and I drew the last two slots while that was going on. The board has the times on it.
The analyser has been back on the header since the quarterly service on the 8th.
